topic: A4 Images and camera identification: loss paths at 95cf6f86, what B3 changed, and what an Anthropic vision + web_search path replaces
summary:
At 95cf6f86 all seven image loss paths from the S80 digest are still open. B3 (#365) only changed identification, and only behind the dark flag ENABLE_VISION_IDENTITY_V2. B4 (URL-mode images, ENABLE_URL_MODE_V2) is not on main. B7 (ENABLE_IMAGE_PIPELINE_V2) was never built. Most orchestrator line numbers moved by about 38. Image race: scs:5977-5990. Piggyback: scs:6123-6127. Stash: scs:5748-5755 / 5813-5819 / 5934-5945.

How images are found today. Every compare resolves the image fresh, in a 5 s race (scs:5785), with no cache. The tiers run in this order:
- Tier 1.5 piggyback: in practice always None.
- Tier 1.5b: Knowledge Graph, organic or inline image from the unified search; free, and no identity check.
- Tier 1: Serper Images [0]. Paid, with a daily budget (SERPER_IMAGE_DAILY_BUDGET, default 500). The budget check is a blocking Upstash INCRBY on the event loop.
- Tier 3: the standard model (gpt-4o-mini) picks a URL from the organic results.

The validator accepts http://. That is a new problem I found: iOS App Transport Security will refuse such a URL, and the tile drops to the placeholder. This is inferred, because app.json has no ATS override.

What B3 changed (flag OFF in production):
- One vision call with a strict json_schema and a 20 s timeout (wait_for). Base64 data URI, detail auto.
- Each product records which photo (image_index) it came from; non-products (is_product false) are dropped.
- Confidence and category are carried, but nothing gates on them; that refusal is B2's job.
- Signed-in scans get personalisation.

The client contract is unchanged: action error, need_second_product, comparison, comparison_failed, and a coded 503 LLM_UNAVAILABLE.

An Anthropic replacement needs four pieces:
1. Identification on claude-haiku-5-5. Image blocks, with no detail field. output_config.format with the B3 schema. No temperature parameter (Haiku 5.5 returns a 400 on any non-default value, and the code sends 0). Thinking is on by default and counts against max_tokens. Handle stop_reason refusal; Haiku has no fallback. Escalate to claude-sonnet-5-5 when confidence is low or the name is unknown.
2. Image finding from our own knowledge base first, then from images we already hold (the JSON-LD cand['image'] that is thrown away today). web_search returns page URLs, not image URLs. So a server fetch under robots fail-closed must read og:image / JSON-LD. Fragrantica and Parfumo must be blocked by domain.
3. One validator: absolute https, a public host (reuse the SSRF validator), and a raster content-type.
4. A new product_images record storing URL and provenance only, never the image file. Write the image into the early buffer so a partial result keeps it.

Switching provider also changes the consent and legal text and forces a new consent ask.

findings.claim: The text-mode image cascade at 95cf6f86 is: Tier 1.5 piggyback, then Tier 1.5b (Knowledge Graph first, then organic, then the inline images pack), then Tier 1 Serper Images[0] (paid, budget-gated), then Tier 3 GPT pick from up to 10 organic results, else None. Validation is only a string starting with http:// or https://.

Timeouts and budget. The whole image race is capped at 5.0 s and runs in parallel with specs (8 s), price (15 s) and reviews (10 s). Serper Images has a daily Redis counter (SERPER_IMAGE_DAILY_BUDGET, default 500, 36 h TTL), fails open when Redis is down, is checked with a synchronous incrby on the event loop, and also sits under the lifetime gate SERPER_LIFETIME_LIMIT.

findings.claim: Loss path 1 is still open: the early stash keeps only specs and price (done-callbacks), not the image. A hard cap during the gather loses the image. B3 does not touch this.

Loss paths 2 and 3 are still open. When both specs and reviews are cached, the unified search is skipped, so search_payload and organic are None. On a unified-search timeout, ENABLE_UNIFIED_SEARCH_BOUND returns {organic: []}. Either way the free Tier 1.5b and Tier 3 have no input, and only paid Serper Images remains.

findings.claim: The Knowledge-Graph-first image has no identity or category check, so a misidentified or placeholder name such as 'Unknown Unknown Product' gets whatever Google matched. B3 adds a category and product_type, but nothing feeds them into image selection.
evidence: C:/Users/SynAckITPC/Documents/AI/sc-s80-b2/app/api/image_routes.py:482-484 - query built from brand and name, placeholders included

findings.claim: V1 camera call (production, flag OFF): one user message with one text prompt plus image_url parts as data:<mime>;base64 with detail auto. The vision model defaults to gpt-4o-mini, with max_tokens 500 and temperature 0. There is no response_format and no wait_for. The reply must be a bare JSON array. Products are normalised to five keys (brand 'Unknown', name 'Unknown Product', confidence default 'medium'), and confidence is never read downstream. Cost is hardcoded at mini prices.
evidence: C:/Users/SynAckITPC/Documents/AI/sc-s80-b2/app/services/openai_service.py:618-643 - data URI, detail auto, guarded_llm_create 500 tokens

findings.claim: B3 V2 call (ENABLE_VISION_IDENTITY_V2, default OFF). Adds VISION_PROMPT_V2 (0-based image_index, no invention, Arabic transliteration, nine categories) and a strict json_schema vision_products_v2 with ten required fields, using an anyOf category branch. max_tokens is 1000 under wait_for(VISION_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=20). A refusal or no content raises LLMUnavailableError; finish_reason=length is a parse failure. The normaliser keeps one best candidate per image_index (two for a single image), and places unpaired candidates last. Underscore keys are stripped from every wire body.

Camera route contract. 400s: no image, more than 4, empty, over 10 MB, unsupported mime (HEIC sniffed). A vision exception gives a coded 503 LLM_UNAVAILABLE when transient, else a 500. Other exits: parse error gives action error; moderation block gives need_second_product; 0 products gives action error; 1 product gives need_second_product (success true); 2 or more give compare_from_text(products[0] vs products[1]). Every non-delivery refunds through latched reserved and anon refunds. An unsuccessful compare under the envelope gives comparison_failed carrying the result code. The client shows 'need_more_photos' for need_second_product, 'timeout' for comparison_failed, 'engine_unavailable' for outage codes, and 'vision_failed' only for action error.

Client upload: every photo is resized to 1024 px wide, re-encoded as JPEG at quality 0.8, and sent as multipart with a bearer token, under an AbortController deadline. The backend can therefore assume JPEG of roughly 1024x(768-1365) for any vision provider.

findings.claim:
ProductImage client states:
- usable URL (non-empty string): an Image with onError, resizeMethod resize, tone background visible while loading and no glyph.
- null, undefined, blank or onError: a placeholder with a phone glyph for every category.
The error state resets when the URL changes; there is no retry and no status text.

Anthropic vision replacement constraints. Model id claude-haiku-5-5 at $0.10/$0.50 per MTok (prompts up to 100K tokens), claude-sonnet-5-5 at $2/$10. Haiku 5.5 returns a 400 on any non-default temperature, so sampling_kwargs(model, 0) must omit it. Thinking is adaptive by default and counts toward max_tokens. Structured output goes through output_config.format, not response_format. Refusal is an HTTP 200 with stop_reason refusal, and Haiku has no server-side fallback. Image blocks are {type:image, source:{type:base64|url, media_type, data}} with no detail parameter. Haiku 5.5 vision resolution and per-image limits were not in the bundled docs.

findings.claim: The Anthropic server web_search tool cannot directly replace image finding. Its results are page URLs and titles, not image URLs. web_search_20260209 (dynamic filtering) is documented only for Opus and Sonnet 5.x/4.6, so Haiku 5.5 probably gets the basic web_search_20250305. web_fetch fetches only URLs already in the conversation, runs on Anthropic's fetcher (whose agents Fragrantica and Parfumo robots disallow), and returns document text that may not carry og:image metadata.

findings.claim: No image persistence exists anywhere. image_url is never cached in L1 or L2, and the only image-bearing store is the off-clock Zyte seed. The submitted Notes v3 B forbids hosting image copies but allows linking to the store's own URL, so a knowledge-base image row must store URL plus provenance, never the image file.

Correction to the S80 digest: the 'piggyback at scs:6086-6090' and 'image task scs:5940-5952' anchors were at 683f56c0. At 95cf6f86 they are scs:6123-6127 and scs:5977-5990 (shifted by the B1/B3 inserts). The content is unchanged, and the 7-path analysis itself is still correct.

Cost of Haiku 5.5 vision per scan, estimated: two 1024x~1000 JPEGs at about 1,400 tokens each plus about 1,200 prompt tokens is about 4k input tokens ($0.0004), plus about 500 output and thinking tokens ($0.00025), so under $0.001 per scan. $400 of credits covers several hundred thousand scans at Haiku rates, before any Sonnet escalation or web_search fees.
evidence: image-token rule of thumb w*h/750 (unverified for Haiku 5.5)

recommendations: Port B3's V2 contract to Haiku 5.5 behind a new provider flag, default OFF and read per call. Reuse VISION_RESPONSE_FORMAT_V2's schema in output_config.format and keep the same normaliser and wire keys, so the build-3 client contract (error, need_second_product, comparison, comparison_failed, 503 LLM_UNAVAILABLE) is unchanged.

Make the provider seam drop temperature for Claude models (Haiku 5.5 returns a 400 on any non-default temperature, and sampling_kwargs sends 0). Size max_tokens for adaptive thinking, set effort low, map stop_reason refusal to the existing LLMUnavailableError, and handle max_tokens like V2's finish_reason=length.

Gate Sonnet 5.5 escalation on the V2 signals already counted (confidence low, unknown_name or unknown_brand, unpaired_index). One retry per scan keeps cost bounded while fixing the hard Arabic-label and no-label cases.

Close loss path 5 first, at zero cost. Map the JSON-LD image already captured as cand['image'] (price_service.py:10964) into price['image_url'], so the dead piggyback (scs:6123-6127) fires for every scraped PDP.
Add the image to the early stash (a done-callback, as with specs and price) so a hard-cap partial at the gather keeps its image (loss path 1).

Create an owned product_images record holding URL, source_host, source_page_url, method, content_type, verified_at, last_status and fail_count, keyed on the specs cache identity, plus a Redis L1 entry. Read it before any tier. That removes paths 2, 3, 4 and 6 for repeat products and stops paying Serper per compare. Never store the image file (Notes v3 B).

Use web_search only to discover a product page, not as an image source. The server then fetches that page under robots fail-closed (a challenge means stop) and reads JSON-LD/og:image. Set blocked_domains for fragrantica.com and parfumo.* on every web_search and web_fetch call.

Tighten the single URL validator: absolute https only (closes the ATS loss), a public host through the existing SSRF url_validator, and a raster content-type (jpeg/png/webp) from a bounded HEAD or range request at write time. Do it under a new flag, because test_image_service_edges.py:22 pins http as valid.

Add an identity check before persisting an image: the source page's product title must match the brand and name, or the category must match B3's vision category. Do not persist placeholder identities ('Unknown Product'). This stops the Knowledge-Graph violin/watch class.
Move try_consume_serper_image_credit off the event loop, or drop Tier 1 once the knowledge base serves images. It is a blocking Upstash incrby inside the 5 s race.

Treat the provider switch as a legal change. Privacy policy, processors.json and the AI-consent copy name OpenAI, so bump AI_CONSENT_VERSION through the U8 machinery and re-ask consent before the flag flips.
Client, for 1.0.1 (OTA after approval): replace the phone glyph with a per-category glyph, and add one retry on onError. No native change is needed.
open_questions: Does Haiku 5.5 accept the B3 schema exactly (anyOf with null, type ['string','null']) under output_config.format together with image blocks? The supported JSON-schema subset was not in the bundled docs; it needs one live smoke run.
What are Haiku 5.5's vision resolution, image-token cost and per-image size limit? Query the Models API capabilities.
Which web_search version does Haiku 5.5 support (20260209 or only 20250305)? What does it cost per search today, and can it be combined with output_config.format in one call?
Is OPENAI_MODEL_VISION set on web? Production state is unrecorded (R-A15), so the true V1 baseline model is unknown.
Does the expected iOS ATS default hold for the shipped build-3 binary? Measure how many delivered image_url values are http:// in stored full_response rows.
Will the owner accept a short HEAD/range request to retailer CDNs at knowledge-base write time? It must honour robots fail-closed.
How should the knowledge base key product identity (the specs cache key vs a new canonical product id) so camera, typed and URL inputs resolve to the same image row?
